rounds.text: Birla Cable Ltd is exhibiting powerful fundamental acceleration supported by a massive 235% compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months [E21] and a 17% increase in compounded sales growth over the same period [E17]. This momentum is highlighted by quarterly operating margins expanding to 9% in March 2026 compared to 5% in the year-ago quarter [E31], alongside a rules-based screen scoring an impressive 82 out of 100 [E61]. Furthermore, the company maintains a healthy dividend payout of 50.0% [E59] while demonstrating exceptional relative strength with a rating of 100 against the Nifty 500 [E51]. On valuation, the stock trades at a price-to-book ratio of 1.12x against a sector benchmark of 4.6x [E7], offering a significant discount on asset value. Conceded: the company has a low return on equity of 5.02% over the last 3 years [E60] and generated negative operating cash flow of Rs -21 Cr in March 2026 [E35].

Birla Cable Ltd carries significant valuation and operational risks that are not supported by the underlying fundamentals. The stock trades at a lofty P/E of 35.1x [E1], while a discounted cash flow model puts intrinsic value at Rs 185 per share against a market price of Rs 194, leaving a negative margin of safety of -5.0% [E45, E46]. Furthermore, the reverse DCF indicates that today's price already demands a steep 15.7% earnings growth rate [E47]. This expensive pricing is compounded by weak and deteriorating profitability metrics, including a low 3-year median ROE of 5% [E28], a trailing ROE of 6.2% [E13], and an ROCE of 8.9% that lags the sector benchmark of 14.19% [E10, E12]. Operational efficiency is further undermined by a negative cash conversion of -1.24x as operating cash flow plunged to Rs -21 Cr and free cash flow dropped to Rs -23 Cr in Mar 2026 [E34, E35, E36], alongside rising borrowings of Rs 133 Cr [E39] and an inconsistent yearly operating margin trend [E32]. Conceded: the company demonstrates strong recent sales and profit growth alongside positive institutional money flow and high relative strength [E17, E21, E44, E51, E62, E64].
